title: Add Burnview Inspector UI and per-tenant alert throttling
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add Burnview Inspector dashboard for token burn analysis and a tenant-scoped alert throttle to reduce noisy alert storms; includes minor Prometheus metric additions and a synthetic probe harness for alert calibration.
description: Motivation: On a number of multi-tenant incidents we observed alert storms triggered by tenant-level token bursts causing noisy paging and masked root causes. This PR introduces two complementary features: 1) Burnview Inspector: a focused observability surface that shows per-tenant token burn over time with breakdown by model variant, stage (prompt vs completion), and hardware tier; and 2) Tenant Alert Throttle: a runtime/alerting shim that rate-limits noisy per-tenant alerts and escalates persistent issues to cross-tenant channels. The PR also adds a lightweight synthetic probe harness that can inject representative invocation traces and cost spikes to validate alert curves and TTLs. High-level changes: added a Burnview API endpoint (observability service) that aggregates prefix/KV cache hit-adjusted token accounting and exposes Prometheus-compatible metrics (redwood_burnview_tenant_tokens_total, redwood_burnview_tenant_tokens_by_stage, redwood_burnview_probe_success), updated tracing spans to add burn.view.{tenant,stage} attributes and a new span kind burn.probe for synthetic probes, introduced a tenant_alert_throttle component in the alerting gateway with per-tenant sliding-window counters and an exponential backoff escalation policy, and added a Grafana dashboard (dashboards/burnview-inspector.json) and alerting rule templates (alerts/burnview-throttle.rules.yaml). Testing: unit tests for aggregation and throttle logic, integration test that replays synthetic probe traces into the observability pipeline, and manual visual QA of the Burnview dashboard. Rollout plan: feature gated by runtime flag observability.burnview.enabled and alert throttle default disabled for 48 hours in canary; monitor burnview_probe_success and alert_rate_reduction metrics before enabling globally. Linear/JIRA: ENG-1912 implements the throttle algorithm; PM-88 tracks dashboard UX. Notes and caveats: the aggregation endpoint currently samples large tenants to preserve query latency; sampling knobs are exposed in config and will be tuned during canary. This change does not alter billing records; token accounting here is for observability only.
